verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests Helicone tracks cost and shows charts. Docs say Alerts monitor costs on LLM requests, and users praise the 'extra charts and logging' and seeing 'how much it costs' per chain. HQL querying and PostHog export support custom analysis, but no first-party docs describe a dashboard breaking down cost and tokens by request, model, and time period. Missing for 10: documented cost/token dashboard, per-model breakdown, time-period aggregation views, explicit per-request token counts.
